SurfaceAreaTooltip: Total area of all mesh surfaces.
VertexCountTooltip: Number of vertices used by the mesh.
TrisCountTooltip: Total number of tris in the mesh.
TrisDensityTooltip: Triangle count relative to the model's size or surface area.
TrisReductionTooltip: Percentage of tris removed from the original mesh.
NoLODButSmall: Mesh is small and does not necessarily need to have LODs.
MinimalLODReduction: LODs provide very little triangle reduction.
HighTrisDensity: Mesh geometry is dense relative to its size.
ComplexSmallMesh: Small mesh contains a high amount of geometry.
HeavyMeshNoLOD: Mesh has high tris with no LODs.
HeavyMeshNoLODCheeky: Mesh is a triangle bomb with no LODs.
LODHeavier: LOD has more tris than previous.
LODIdentical: LOD has identical tris to previous.
Option.EnableVanilla.Label: Enable vanilla
Option.EnableVanilla.Desc: Show mesh data for assets using vanilla RenderPrefabs.
Option.ViewChooser.Label: Choose view
Option.ViewChooser.Desc: Choose which view to use to show information about the mesh on the Selected Info Panel (Default Tabular).
Option.LOD1Threshold.Label: LOD1 Threshold
Option.LOD1Threshold.Desc: Set the tris reduction threshold for LOD1 used to display the warning symbol. (Default 50%)
Option.LOD2Threshold.Label: LOD2 Threshold
Option.LOD2Threshold.Desc: Set the tris reduction threshold for LOD2 used to display the warning symbol. (Default 80%)
Option.TrisThreshold.Label: Tris Threshold
Option.TrisThreshold.Desc: Set the tris threshold used to determine whether a mesh is high-density or requires LODs. (Default 5,000)
Option.VolumeThreshold.Label: Volume Threshold
Option.VolumeThreshold.Desc: Set the volume threshold used to determine whether a mesh is considered small. (Default 1m³)
Option.CheekyMode.Label: Cheeky Mode
Option.CheekyMode.Desc: Use various emoji and alternate texts for the warning messages.
